bundle.shortDescription: A free, fast desktop database client
bundle.longDescription: TableMax is a free, fast desktop database client for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB and SQLite: browse schemas and tables in a virtualized grid, run SQL in an editor with syntax highlighting, connect over SSL/TLS or SSH tunnels, and confirm writes on production connections with safe mode. Passwords stay in the system keyring.
